Name: Domesticated Dust Sprites
Author: StormDrakon
Description:
[center][color=#3d85c6][size=5][b]Domesticated Dust Sprites[/b][/size][/color][color=#ff7700][size=5][b]
[/b][/size][/color][color=#ff7700][color=#ffffff][u]-For Stardew 1.6 use with Content Patcher-[/u][/color][/color]﻿ [/center]

This mod adds eight different color skins of the wild dust sprites from the mines. The colors are blue (wild coloring), grey, albino, pygmy, purple, pink, gold, and green. The colors are just visual, they all drop the same items: Small and Large coal chunks.

Put the coal chunks in a charcoal kiln to get multiple coal!
﻿Small Coal Chunks: 2 - 4 coal
﻿Large Coal Chunks: 5 - 10 coal

Never hurt a dust sprite again! Just get a Domesticated Dust Sprite today!



[u]Installation Guide for Content Patcher for Stardew 1.6:[/u]

[b] ﻿1.[/b] Install SMAPI and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
﻿[b]2.[/b] Run the game at least once to make sure there are no existing problems
﻿[b]3.[/b] Download the Domesticated Dust Sprites file and drag and drop the entire unzipped [CP] Dust Sprites folder from the download into ﻿your Stardew Valley\Mods



This is not a replacer mod, this will add new animals to Marnies ranch for purchase for 2000 g.

This mod was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/158720243]WickedyWoah[/url] Dust sprites in the coop mod. The art and files in this mod are my own since Wickedys mod broke awhile back but i love the idea of their mod so much that i created this one from scratch so i could play something similar again.
